$comment: The website's source of truth. Every feature branch merged to main adds an entry to `changes` (newest first) and keeps `plugins` in step with src/plugins/. `mise run site:build` validates this file; `mise run site:check` fails a branch that does not touch it. Format: src/site/README.md.

site.title: Deimos Rose
site.tagline: Deimos Rising (2003), rebuilt from its own bytes
site.description: A faithful Odin and raylib reimplementation of the 2003 vertical shooter Deimos Rising, with rollback netplay and new content as optional plugins.

pitch.title: The original, exactly
pitch.body: Classic mode replays the shipped 2003 demo films random call for random call: the same sprites, colours, frames and timing, checked against the original binary running under Wine.

pitch.title: A small core
pitch.body: The core is the original game and nothing more. Everything Deimos Rose adds is a plugin, switched on or off from the Mods page.

pitch.title: Rollback netplay
pitch.body: Two players online, with rollback, desync detection and reconnection, built on a simulation that is pure and deterministic by construction.

plugins.name: recovered_levels
plugins.about: Each original map was lifted back into a height field, relit, and repainted in the level editor.

plugins.name: fps_unlock
plugins.about: The simulation still steps at the original 30 Hz; frames in between are drawn from both sides of a step.

plugins.name: hd_textures
plugins.about: Upscaled by the Nomos SPAN 2x model; classic mode always draws the originals.

plugins.name: new_weapons
plugins.about: The Discharge Beam: an instant laser that carries leftover damage through its kills and chains between targets when charged.

changes.title: One copy of the game's state
changes.summary: A plugin loaded from its own library would carry a private copy of everything the game keeps, and its registrations would never reach the game. Every package now keeps its state in one block, which a loaded plugin is pointed at: the groundwork for installing plugins separately.
highlights: 142 package variables across 29 packages moved into 28 blocks, or became read-only tables.
`mise run purity` fails any new variable outside a block.
All 25 recorded films, the damage report and every menu screen are unchanged; a simulation step takes as long as before.

changes.title: The core names no plugin
changes.summary: The game used to call seven of its plugins by name, so it could not be built without them. Now each plugin registers what it adds, and the game only asks: the first step to installing plugins separately.
highlights: Level Select and lobby switches, launch flags, frame pacing, the Extras previews and the netplay pause are all registered by their plugins.
`-mod <name>` switches any plugin on for one run.
`mise run purity` fails any core file that imports a plugin.
Classic play, all 25 recorded films and every menu screen are unchanged.

changes.title: A website, and feature branches with reviewed pull requests
changes.summary: This site. A dependency-free Node script builds it from this config before every deployment to GitHub Pages, so it is never edited by hand and cannot fall behind main.
highlights: Work happens on feature branches, merged by pull request.
Every branch adds its entry here; CI fails a pull request that does not.
The plugin catalogue is checked against src/plugins/ on every build.

changes.title: Level editor and remastered levels
changes.summary: deimos-editor: sculpt, light, paint and populate levels, then export a campaign as a plugin the game plays. All twelve originals recovered as editable projects.

changes.title: ECS refactor and mods
changes.summary: The simulation moved onto an entity component system, its behaviour into registered systems, and Deimos Rose's additions into plugins toggled from a Mods page. The oracle diff stayed exact throughout.

changes.title: New weapons, easy mode and passive upgrades
changes.summary: A loadout screen, the Chaingun and the Discharge Beam; nine passives offered after each level in easy mode; a DPS report that tunes them by measurement.

changes.title: Rollback netplay
changes.summary: A snapshot ring, a UDP transport, rollback, desync detection, a lobby, reconnection and synchronised pausing.

changes.title: The faithful port
changes.summary: Asset extraction, a decompilation corpus of 1,942 named functions, a deterministic simulation that replays every shipped demo film exactly, and the full game playable from title screen to the last level.
